name: Nook
why_included: Coworking feel: large communal table, bar, couch nooks, ample outlets, fast wifi; good for a group.

name: Daily Press Coffee (Somers St)
why_included: Called coworking-friendly; plenty of seating, wifi, outlets, natural light; room for groups.

name: Santander Work Cafe (Williamsburg)
why_included: Free coworking-style cafe open to anyone with desks, wifi and seating; check bank hours. Group-friendly tables.

name: Manhattanville Coffee (Harlem Collective)
why_included: Outlet-lined tables and central island inside a co-working building; 2022 source, verify WiFi.

name: Ground Support Cafe
why_included: Outlets, laptop-friendly; shared long tables suit groups; limited space.

name: Kinship Coffee Roasters (21st St)
why_included: Strong wifi, plenty of indoor and outdoor seating (Infatuation, Sep 2026).

name: Pacific Library
why_included: Near Barclays Center; reservable meeting rooms; open to 8pm Tue/Thu. Group via room booking.

name: 180 Maiden Lane atrium
why_included: APOPS calls it downtown's best indoor POPS; 24 tables, 120 chairs, restrooms, kiosk; visitors report wifi, limited outlets. Group.

name: Stephen A. Schwarzman Building - Rose Main Reading Room
why_included: Rose Main Reading Room open for quiet study without appointment; free wifi and outlets at long tables. Silent, solo work only.

name: Mulberry Street Library
why_included: Converted chocolate factory; underground adult reading rooms with work tables, plenty of outlets and comfortable seating (NYU News 2023).
